4 Vectors & Matrices [1 mark]
In the graph below, the straight line is represented by y=2x+1y = 2x + 1y=2x+1. What are the coordinates of the y-intercept?
A. (0,2)(0, 2)(0,2)
B. (2,1)(2, 1)(2,1)
C. (1,0)(1, 0)(1,0)
D. (0,1)(0, 1)(0,1) ✓
Correct Answer: (D) — (0,1)(0, 1)(0,1)
The y-intercept occurs when the value of x is 0. Substitute x = 0 into the equation y=2x+1y = 2x + 1y=2x+1:

y=2(0)+1y = 2(0) + 1y=2(0)+1
y=0+1y = 0 + 1y=0+1
y=1y = 1y=1

Therefore, the coordinates of the y-intercept are (0, 1).

25 Statistics & Probability [1 mark]
The box plot shows the distribution of scores for 50 students on a math test. If the first quartile (Q1) of the scores is 65 and the third quartile (Q3) is 85, what is the interquartile range (IQR) of these scores?
A. 252525
B. 150150150
C. 757575
D. 202020 ✓
Correct Answer: (D) — 202020
The Interquartile Range (IQR) is a measure of statistical dispersion, defined as the difference between the third quartile (Q3) and the first quartile (Q1).
IQR=Q3−Q1\text{IQR} = Q3 - Q1IQR=Q3−Q1
Substituting the given values:
IQR=85−65\text{IQR} = 85 - 65IQR=85−65
IQR=20\text{IQR} = 20IQR=20
Therefore, the interquartile range is 20.
26 Limits & Differential Calculus [1 mark]
The graph of the function f(x)f(x)f(x) and its tangent line at x=2x=2x=2 is shown below. If the equation of the tangent line is y=3x−1y = 3x - 1y=3x−1, what is the value of f′(2)f'(2)f′(2)?
A. −1-1−1
B. 111
C. 222
D. 333 ✓
Correct Answer: (D) — 333
The derivative of a function f(x) at a point x=ax=ax=a, denoted f′(a)f'(a)f′(a), represents the slope of the tangent line to the curve of f(x)f(x)f(x) at that point. In this problem, we are given the equation of the tangent line as y=3x−1y = 3x - 1y=3x−1. This equation is in the slope-intercept form y=mx+by = mx + by=mx+b, where mmm is the slope and bbb is the y-intercept. By comparing the equation of the tangent line y=3x−1y = 3x - 1y=3x−1 with the general form y=mx+by = mx + by=mx+b, we see that the slope of the tangent line is m=3m = 3m=3. Since the slope of the tangent line at x=2x=2x=2 is f′(2)f'(2)f′(2), we have f′(2)=3f'(2) = 3f′(2)=3.
